items.title: Bitcoin ETF inflows hit $3.8B in strongest three-week stretch of 2026
items.summary: US spot Bitcoin ETFs drew nearly $1 billion in the latest week as Friday inflows stayed positive despite Bitcoin briefly falling below $79,000.

items.title: XRP Ledger has fewer active accounts than last year, but bigger trades and more value
items.summary: Daily order-book traders fell about 40% from a year ago while volume rose 79%, as the value held on XRPL climbed above $4 billion.

items.title: TikTok's Parent Company Just Borrowed $30 Billion to Go All-In on AI
items.summary: Nearly 30 banks backed the rare unsecured facility as TikTok’s parent company spends heavily on AI chips, models, and overseas data centers.

items.title: Robinhood Chain Never Stopped But its Blobs Did Stop Reaching Ethereum For 14 Minutes
items.summary: Blocks came every 101 milliseconds throughout the outage reported on Friday.
